```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Federal research dollars should be spent as though lives are at stake because lives are at stake.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Research protocols must consider the special needs of formerly neglected groups to make significant progress against breast and prostate cancer, diabetes, and other killers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Taxpayer-funded medical research must be based on sound science, with a focus on both prevention and treatment, and in accordance with the humane ethics of the Hippocratic Oath.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for a major expansion of support for stem-cell research that shows promise and offers hope for scores of diseases—with adult stem cells, umbilical cord blood, and cells reprogrammed into pluripotent stem cells—without the destruction of embryonic human life.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A ban on human cloning is called for.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A ban on the creation of or experimentation on human embryos for research purposes is called for.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Medicines and treatments should be designed to prolong and enhance life, not destroy it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Federal funds should not be used for drugs that cause the destruction of human life.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Drug Enforcement Administration ban on use of controlled substances for physician-assisted suicide should be restored.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
